create_parameter: create a learnable Parameter instance with a value and a unique name for use in a Penzai neural network model
build_frozen_parameter: build a FrozenParameter instance to store a non-learnable parameter that will not be updated during optimization
initialize_parameters: initialize all UninitializedParameter instances in a model using a PRNG key derived from parameter names for reproducible initialization
mark_shareable_parameters: mark all uninitialized parameters in a submodel as shareable so they can be shared across multiple layers via attach_shared_parameters
add_parameter_prefix: add a prefix to all parameter names inside a tree to avoid name conflicts when combining sublayers into a larger model
